reasoning: The native definition issues a complete nine-reaction route from supplied DHB and lysine to both myxochelin endpoints. The primary experiments support the complete chemistry, while the proposed first amidation order is explicitly unknown in the inspected 2001 primary.

Unknown experimental order is not a demonstrated opposite order or a source structural contradiction. The native N6 intermediate can be represented as a qualified structured-database assertion, provided the exact specificity is not attributed to the experiment or asserted as an established exclusive physiological sequence.

The repository add-pathway rule permits inspected database assertions with their evidence tier and limitations. Qualification must be attached to every affected assertion and survive evidence export; a description-only disclaimer is insufficient.

Independent exact-original inspection found no endpoint structural identity defect requiring route truncation: B matches CHEBI7061 exactly; A must retain its native stereospecific identity instead of an exact mapping to unspecified CHEBI31877.

Explicitly identify N6-first as the selected database convention in their participant, input/output, catalyst-role and ordering evidence. Add separate primary evidence for unresolved first amidation. Do not rename the native class to unspecified or claim the primary proves N6-first.

Retain all nine native objects and both endpoint branches. Keep PWY-5901 as a distinct supplied-precursor route and exclude composite RXN-23309/RXN-23311 from the graph to avoid double counting their component transformations.

Use native CPD-25904 for stereospecific A; do not assert exactMatch to CHEBI31877. Native CPD-25905 and CHEBI7061 have identical full InChIs and may support an exact source-derived identity bridge. Native CPD-25916 grounds the free aldehyde.

Native AF299336.1 translations match Q9F638/Q9F637/Q9F636/Q9F631. Retain original Sg a15/current taxon675526 versus species-level unreviewed UniProt41, and distinguish native sequence equality from tagged/processed experimental preparation identity.

Treat the six carrier objects as reactive-state classes. Do not invent whole-protein formulas, exact tagged states, carrier molecule counts, fixed E:F:G:L assemblies or a native PPTase from heterologous MtaA coexpression.

Reject shared DHBAMPLIG-RXN VibE/CPLX-7945 cross-organism controller inheritance; use the selected MxcE native/protein/primary evidence. The 2001 proposal alone is not direct MxcL assay evidence; cite the 2008 primary/SI separately.

Reverse RXN-23314 according to its physiological RIGHT-TO-LEFT annotation. Retain NADPH selection plus measured slower NADH alternative, directly supported MxcL PLP, and assay-only Mg limits. The 3 ATP endpoint cost is a derived equation, not a directly measured ratio.

The later full record must preserve these limits in source-local evidence and generated export, resolve normal issuing-authority labels, and receive independent whole-record review. If exports erase the uncertainty, hold the record rather than silently presenting a demonstrated N6-first route.
